title: (3.0beta5) Frozen screen/app crashes/update basal profile error
symptom: Screen freezes sometimes when switching profile, app crashes with 'wait or close' message, connection with Combo pump appears slower, and 'Update of basal profile failed' error occurs at night or during the day.
cause: The root cause is not definitively identified. Suspicions include a possible ringbuffer overrun inside the Combo pump, or an issue triggered by Android 12, but no conclusive cause was established.
fix: No definitive fix was found. User tried increasing sleep period in SetBasalProfileCommand from 50 to 200/250, resetting Bluetooth/WiFi/mobile, and reinstalling AAPS and Ruffy, but without success. Switching to a different phone (Samsung S21 Ultra with Android 11) resolved the freezes but basal profile update errors persisted.
evidence_quote: I have done this change to 200 several days ago and build a new apk. I don't see any changes :(. Or do I something wrong? I have also tried 250.
